headline: Anthropic Prepares IPO Pricing as Cheap Chinese Models Pressure AI Margins
summary: AI developer Anthropic is set to price its initial public offering on Wednesday. The IPO comes as low-cost Chinese artificial intelligence models exert margin pressure on Western developers.
why: Anthropic creates LLM models such as Claude. Its public market listing serves as a major valuation benchmark for generative AI startups.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Public market listing provides fresh capital while competitive pressures from lower-priced models challenge pricing power.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
